name: Immich Kiosk
short_desc: Highly configurable slideshows for Immich photos and videos.
author: Damon Golding
description: Immich Kiosk displays Immich photos and videos in highly customizable slideshows for browsers and devices such as tablets, TVs, and digital picture frames.

form_fields.label: Immich URL
form_fields.hint: Internal URL of your Immich server (e.g. http://immich:2283 or http://host.docker.internal:8128).

form_fields.label: Immich API Key
form_fields.hint: API key created in Immich with the permissions listed in the Immich Kiosk docs.

form_fields.label: Immich External URL
form_fields.hint: Optional public Immich URL used for image links and QR codes.

form_fields.label: Language
form_fields.hint: Language code for Kiosk UI (e.g. en_US, en_GB).
